title: Updated online versions of the tax Acts as at 1 January 2026 (ITA 1967, Stamp Act 1949, RPGT Act 1976, LBATA 1990, PITA 1967)
summary: HASiL replaced the consolidated online versions of five Acts on its Legislation > Act page with versions as at 1 January 2026: Income Tax Act 1967 (Act 53), Stamp Act 1949 (Act 378), Real Property Gains Tax Act 1976 (Act 169), Labuan Business Activity Tax Act 1990 (Act 445) and Petroleum (Income Tax) Act 1967 (Act 543). The Promotion of Investments Act 1986 stays as at 1 January 2022.
replaces: Earlier online versions: ITA 1967 (file dated 21/05/2024), Stamp Act 1949 (01/01/2024), RPGT Act 1976 (01/06/2023), LBATA 1990 (01/01/2024); PITA 1967 was already as at 1 January 2026 and was re-uploaded

title: Tax case report: MDCOGL v. Director General of Inland Revenue (SCIT, 21/10/2026) – interest income of a non-resident with a PE taxed at 24%, not 15%
publication_date: 21/10/2026 (decision); added to HASiL Tax Case page 30/10/2026
summary: The Special Commissioners of Income Tax dismissed the appeal of a non-resident company with a permanent establishment in Malaysia, which argued that its Malaysian-sourced interest for YAs 2016–2018 should be taxed at 15% under s.6(1)(b)(i) ITA 1967. The DGIR's position was upheld: the interest was connected to its Malaysian business, so it was taxable at the 24% corporate rate under s.6(1)(a), and the 15% rate only applies where the s.109 withholding mechanism applies. The additional assessments (Form JA) and penalties were confirmed; the taxpayer may appeal within 21 days.
